rule.universe: NIFTY100 members on 2011-12-31 with complete month ends
rule.val_rule: paired t of squared-error differences >= 1.65 and same sign of b
rule.wiring: first-month shift b/21 per session, b ~ N(b, se^2) per path

why: Tested on India's 10-year yield and 73 names of the NIFTY 100, 2012-2017 to fit and 2018-2021 to check once: a rise of 1 point moved the book by -3.6% a month (give or take 6.9); development t -1.04 against a bar of 3.28; on the check years it predicted monthly moves worse than a plain average (t -0.37 against 1.65).
